canonical_example.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
canonical_example.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

canonical_example.translation: The news about the hurricane is making me nervous.

canonical_example.translation: This ornament won't stand without leaning it on something.

canonical_example.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.

canonical_example.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.

canonical_example.text: Reconocemos la necesidad de reformas en el sistema escolar.
canonical_example.translation: We recognize the need for reform in the school system.

canonical_example.text: Los niños que viven en la mayor necesidad no tienen acceso a una educación.
canonical_example.translation: Children living in greatest need do not have access to an education.

canonical_example.text: Si vives en un lugar tan aislado, un carro es una necesidad.
canonical_example.translation: A car is a necessity if you live in such remote location.

canonical_example.text: Empecé a trabajar por necesidad, no porque quisiera hacerlo.
canonical_example.translation: I started work out of necessity, not because I wanted to.

canonical_example.text: La necesidad lo llevó a buscar una mejor vida en Europa.
canonical_example.translation: Poverty led him to seek a better life in Europe.

canonical_example.text: Los refugiados pasaron muchas necesidades en el camino.
canonical_example.translation: The refugees suffered a lot of hardship on the road.

canonical_example.text: Se vieron obligados a hacer sus necesidades en un balde.
canonical_example.translation: They were obliged to relieve themselves in a bucket.

canonical_example.text: No lo pienses más. ¡Actúa!
canonical_example.translation: Don't think too much. Just do it!

canonical_example.text: Pienso que ya debería estar en casa.
canonical_example.translation: I think he should be home by now.

canonical_example.text: Jaime se piensa que lo sabe todo.
canonical_example.translation: Jaime thinks he knows it all.

canonical_example.text: Estaba pensando estudiar mañana.
canonical_example.translation: I was planning to study tomorrow.

canonical_example.text: Pensé escribirte ayer, pero luego Vanna vino a la casa y se me olvidó.
canonical_example.translation: I meant to write you yesterday, but then Vanna came over and I forgot.

canonical_example.text: Nunca pensé herirte, Felipe. Lo siento.
canonical_example.translation: I never intended to hurt you, Felipe. I'm sorry.

canonical_example.text: Ella se piensa la hija preferida de la familia.
canonical_example.translation: She thinks of herself as the family's favorite child.

canonical_example.text: ¿Vas a aceptar la oferta? - No sé; tendré que pensármelo.
canonical_example.translation: Are you going to accept the offer? - I don't know; I'll have to think about it.

canonical_example.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
canonical_example.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

canonical_example.text: Me voy a poner la camisa que me regalaste.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to wear the shirt you gave me.

canonical_example.translation: The party is formal. You should wear a button-down shirt, not a t-shirt.

canonical_example.text: Si a un libro le falta la camisa, puede que sea robado.
canonical_example.translation: If a book is missing its jacket, it might be stolen.

canonical_example.text: Ten mucho cuidado con esos cables; se les está pelando la camisa.
canonical_example.translation: Be careful with those cables; the casing is peeling.

canonical_example.text: Pela el ojo, porque acabo de ver la camisa de una serpiente de cascabel.
canonical_example.translation: Keep your eyes peeled, because I just saw the slough of a rattlesnake.

canonical_example.translation: The pilot fainted and the copilot took control of the plane.

canonical_example.translation: The driver was pulled out of the wrecked car before it burst into flames.

canonical_example.translation: The rider who collided with me abandoned his bike and ran off.

canonical_example.translation: My dream has always been to pilot a helicopter, so I enrolled in flight school.

canonical_example.translation: The official was suspended for flying his fighter plane dangerously.

canonical_example.text: A lo largo de mi carrera profesional en el motocross, he pilotado muchos tipos distintos de moto.

canonical_example.translation: Mike confessed that he'd never piloted such a large ship.

canonical_example.translation: It would be dangerous to navigate the cargo ship with such a strong swell.

canonical_example.text: Es su hija mayor quien pilota ahora la empresa.
